steps.title: Enable the addon first
steps.body: This provider is disabled by default. Enable LM Studio (REST) Chat Provider in Addon Manager and restart NC as requested. Until then, its Connection, Model, and Generation areas are not expected to appear. Enabling it changes which transport NC uses, so do this deliberately rather than as a first step.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Check the connection card and test
steps.body: After restart, open the Connection area on this page and read the connection card for the server address it expects. Confirm LM Studio is running locally, then use Test connection to check reachability. A passing connection test confirms the endpoint, not that a model is loaded or that responses are complete.

steps.title: Select a model in the selector
steps.body: Use the model selector to choose a model the running server exposes. If the list is empty, the server likely has no loaded model; address that before repeatedly refreshing. Selecting a model changes what Generation settings apply to, so confirm the name matches what you intended.

steps.title: Generation options apply to REST
steps.body: Generation options shape replies from this REST provider. Read the current values before changing them. If an unfamiliar option appears, treat it as unknown and change one at a time. Verify with a short reply whether the transport switch and model produce expected responses.
